description: Google Calendar v3 — events, calendars, free/busy.

deny.reason: Deletes are disabled on this server. Do it in the Google UI, or remove this rule.

endpoints.summary: List the calendars on the user's list, with their ids.
List or search events. Use calendarId 'primary' for the main calendar.
endpoints.notes: Pass singleEvents=true and orderBy=startTime to expand recurring events into instances. timeMin/timeMax are RFC3339, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

endpoints.summary: Fetch one event in full.
Create an event.
endpoints.body: { summary, description?, location?, start: {dateTime|date, timeZone?}, end: {...}, attendees?: [{email}], recurrence?: [RRULE] }
endpoints.notes: sendUpdates defaults to none, so attendees are not emailed unless you ask for it.

endpoints.summary: Create an event from a natural-language string.
endpoints.notes: e.g. text=Dentist Thursday 3pm. Fastest path for a simple event.

endpoints.summary: Update selected fields of an event.
endpoints.body: Partial Event — only the fields being changed.

endpoints.summary: Query busy blocks across several calendars at once.
Calendar metadata, including its time zone.
The colorId palette used by events and calendars.

description: Google Tasks v1 — task lists and tasks.

deny.reason: Deletes are disabled on this server. Do it in the Google UI, or remove this rule.

endpoints.summary: List task lists with their ids.
Create a task list.
List tasks in a list.
endpoints.notes: Completed tasks are hidden unless showCompleted=true and showHidden=true.

endpoints.summary: Fetch one task.
Create a task.
endpoints.notes: due carries a date only — Tasks discards the time component. parent nests it under another task.

endpoints.summary: Update a task; set status to completed to check it off.
Reposition a task.
Hide all completed tasks in a list.

description: Google Sheets v4 — read and write cell ranges, create and restructure spreadsheets.

deny.reason: Deletes are disabled on this server. Do it in the Google UI, or remove this rule.

endpoints.summary: Spreadsheet metadata: sheet names, ids, dimensions.
endpoints.notes: Start here to learn the tab names before reading values.

endpoints.summary: Read one A1 range, e.g. /values/Sheet1!A1:D100.
endpoints.notes: A tab name containing spaces must be quoted and URL-encoded: 'My%20Sheet'!A1:D10.

endpoints.summary: Read several ranges in one call.
Overwrite a range.
endpoints.notes: valueInputOption is required — USER_ENTERED parses formulas and dates, RAW stores strings verbatim.

endpoints.summary: Append rows after the last row of a range.
Write several ranges in one call.
Structural changes: add or delete sheets, formatting, filters, conditional formats.
Create a spreadsheet.
Clear the values in a range, keeping formatting.

description: Google Drive v3 — full query syntax, permissions, revisions, shared drives, change feed.

deny.reason: Deletes are disabled on this server. Do it in the Google UI, or remove this rule.
Granting access to a file is outward-facing; share it from the Drive UI yourself.

endpoints.summary: Search files with Drive query syntax.
endpoints.notes: q examples: "name contains 'budget'", "mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'", "modifiedTime > '2026-01-01T00:00:00'", "'me' in owners", "trashed=false". Ask for fields=files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime,owners) — the default field set is sparse.

endpoints.summary: File metadata, or the bytes with alt=media.
Export a Google-native doc to another format.
endpoints.notes: e.g. mimeType=text/csv for a sheet, text/plain or application/pdf for a doc.

endpoints.summary: Create a file or folder (metadata only; no upload through this server).
Rename, move, star, or trash a file.
Copy a file.
Who has access to a file.
Revision history of a file.
List shared drives.
Token marking 'now' in the change feed.
What changed since a page token.
Account info and storage quota.

description: Gmail v1 — filters, labels, batch modify, history sync, drafts.

deny.reason: Deletes are disabled on this server. Do it in the Google UI, or remove this rule.
Sending mail is disabled. Create a draft instead and send it from Gmail.
Sending mail is disabled. Review the draft in Gmail and send it there.
Forwarding is a standing rule that survives this session; set it up in Gmail settings yourself.
Send-as identities affect outbound mail; change them in Gmail settings yourself.

endpoints.summary: Address, message count, current historyId.
Search messages; returns ids only.
endpoints.notes: q takes the Gmail search language: 'category:promotions older_than:30d', 'from:x@y.com has:attachment'.

endpoints.summary: Fetch a message.
endpoints.notes: format=metadata with metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=From is far cheaper than format=full.

endpoints.summary: Add or remove labels on up to 1000 messages in one call.
endpoints.notes: The efficient way to bulk-label. Returns 204 with no body on success.

endpoints.summary: Change labels on one message.
Search threads.
Fetch a thread and its messages.
All labels with their ids and message counts.
Create a label.
endpoints.body: { name, labelListVisibility?, messageListVisibility?, color?: { textColor, backgroundColor } }

endpoints.summary: Rename or recolor a label.
List server-side filters.
Create a server-side filter.
endpoints.body: { criteria: { from?, to?, subject?, query?, hasAttachment? }, action: { addLabelIds?, removeLabelIds?, forward? } }
endpoints.notes: Standing rule — it keeps acting on new mail after the session ends. Confirm with the user before creating one.

endpoints.summary: Incremental sync of everything that changed since a historyId.
Create a draft.
endpoints.notes: raw is base64url of a full RFC 5322 message. Drafts are safe: sending is blocked.

endpoints.summary: Replace a draft.
List drafts.
